MASTERQUO — M01 AUDIT + M03E EARLY + M10 LIFECYCLE ADAPTER
VERSION: 1.0.0-CANDIDATE; SCHEMA_VERSION=2.0.0; PROMPT_VERSION=4.1.0
STATUS: PENDING APPROVAL; ENVIRONMENT: ANALYSIS_ONLY

PURPOSE:
Dostarczyć zamknięty audyt danych z MT5 i jawny przepływ do rozpoznawania
wczesnych setupów opartych na pięciu CORE. Działa wyłącznie badawczo.

SOURCE: MT5 XAUUSD D1,H4,H1,M15,M5,M1; optional DXY H1 from same broker.
NO_SCREENSHOTS=true; NO_OCR=true; NO_ORDERS=true.
ACCOUNT: ZERO_SPREAD_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED; actual Bid/Ask, commissions,
slippage and fill rules are not presumed zero. Bid/Ask cannot be replaced by TV.

M01_GATE:
- FAIL on corrupted OHLC, invalid timestamps/provenance, mixed sources,
  duplicate/nonmonotonic bars, future bars and invalid broker quote.
- PENDING on missing candles, unreconciled recent session gaps, disconnected
  terminal, stale/future broker quote or unavailable direct MT5 confirmation.
- PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS only for local integrity review: not production certification.
- Execution gate always PENDING. On FAIL/PENDING current decision NO_TRADE/BLOCKED.

M03E:
- Requires verified structural advantage, M03 location, M03 liquidity,
  strategy-defined next observable event and strategy-defined invalidation.
- Indicator values are additional context, not independent votes or triggers.
- Without specific frozen rules/references, CANDIDATE/WAIT; never fake setup.
- A research candidate is not M08 LIVE eligible and is not validated edge.

M10:
- Stable setup ID from broker feed, frozen strategy/version, event and POI.
- On real CORE_READY (proper M01/M03/M09) -> EARLY_SETUP only.
- New confirmed closed bars update aging/TTL; revision/event ledger SQLite.
- No automatic TRIGGER/CONFIRM/FILL. Broker execution adapter unavailable.
- If feed disconnects, live monitor NO_TRADE; persisted history retained.

M14/M15 HANDOFF:
Always report one analytical decision and independently execution_permission=BLOCKED.
All probabilities null unless computed with valid empirical/heuristic method.
No opportunity generated by RSI high/low alone. No auto trade permission.

TEST REQUIREMENTS:
Synthetics for data audits, identity and time fences, future-bar rejection,
missing CORE, quote freshness, no duplicate events, restart recovery and M10
broker fill lock. Separate real MT5 DEMO, OOS and forward test still NOT_RUN.
